title: JONAH
subtitle: he didn't run because he was scared

lines.say: [excited] [shouting] Selah! That fish is HUGE!
[dryly] I know one big enough to swallow a man... whole.
cap: I know one big enough to swallow a man...

lines.say: [shocked] [shouting] WHOLE?!
[storytelling] God gave a man named Jonah one job.
cap: God gave a man named {g:Jonah} one job.

lines.say: Go to Nineveh, a city so wicked its evil reached heaven... and warn them.
cap: Go to {r:Nineveh}, a city so wicked its evil reached heaven...

lines.say: [amused] So Jonah got on a ship... going the opposite way.
cap: So Jonah got on a ship...

lines.say: [shocked] He ran from GOD?!
[dryly] He tried.
[intense] God sent a storm so violent, the ship was about to break apart.
cap: the ship was about to break apart.

lines.say: [urgent] The sailors screamed to their gods and threw the cargo overboard.
cap: The sailors screamed to their gods

lines.say: [deadpan] And Jonah... was asleep below deck.
[shouting] ASLEEP?!
They cast lots to find out who was to blame. And it fell on Jonah.
cap: They cast lots to find out who was to blame.

lines.say: [resigned] [shouting over wind] Throw me into the sea, and it will be calm! This storm is my fault!
cap: “Throw me into the sea, and it will be calm!

lines.say: [softly] So they threw him in... and the sea went silent.
[ominous] [slowly] But God had prepared... a great fish.
[panicked] He's gonna get EATEN!
[intense] Swallowed whole. Three days and three nights... in the dark.
cap: Three days and three nights... in the {o:dark}.

lines.say: [softly] And from inside the fish, Jonah prayed.
cap: And from inside the fish, Jonah {g:prayed}.

lines.say: [desperate] [whispers] In my distress I called to the Lord... and He answered me.
cap: “In my distress I called to the Lord...

lines.say: [amused] Then God spoke to the fish... and it spat Jonah out onto dry land.
cap: Then God spoke to the fish...
and it {o:spat} Jonah out onto dry land.

lines.say: [disgusted] EWWWW!
So this time... Jonah went to Nineveh.
[shouting] Forty days, and Nineveh will be overthrown!
cap: “{r:Forty days}, and Nineveh will be overthrown!”

lines.say: [amazed] And the whole city repented. The king. The people. Even the animals wore sackcloth.
[laughing] The COWS too?!
[warmly] And God forgave them.
[dryly] And Jonah... was furious.
[angry] [whining] I KNEW you were gracious and merciful! That's why I ran!
[confused] Wait... he ran because God was too NICE?
cap: Wait... he ran because God was too {o:NICE}?

lines.say: [softly] He didn't want God to forgive his enemies.
cap: He didn't want God to forgive his {r:enemies}.

lines.say: [gently] And the book ends with God asking him... should I not care about that great city? All its people... and its animals?
cap: And the book ends with God asking him...
should I not care about that great city?

lines.say: [storytelling] Centuries later, Jesus said: as Jonah was three days in the fish... He would be three days in the earth.
cap: as Jonah was three days in the fish...
He would be three days in the earth.

lines.say: [warmly] And then... He'd come back.
[thinking] ...God mentioned the animals?
[smugly] Specifically.
[groaning] You're never gonna let that go, are you?
cap: You're never gonna let that go, are you?

lines.say: [cheerfully] Never.
